title: Ratification -- one decider's answer on every slate ticket (R34, R36 round 5)
x_purpose: Each decider answers per ticket: AGREE, AGREE_WITH_RESERVATION (say the reservation), or OBJECT with the ONE thing that would clear it. R40 AMENDED 2026-11-19: the trigger is an entry point, not a gate - a disagreement with the trigger is a trigger_note, never an OBJECT, and is not counted. Code counts OBJECT answers (the STOCK only) on the FINAL ratification (pma_pipeline.py ratify-count): 0 = AGREED; 1 to 3 = CONTESTED (listed, objections printed); 4 or more of 7 (half or more of the deciders present) = DROPPED (off the list, still tracked). After a Steenbarger hold the held tickets are ratified again once (forms/ratify2/), and those answers replace the first for those tickets only.

round.x_note: 1 = first ratification, 2 = after a hold (held tickets only)

conviction.x_note: R42, REQUIRED from 2026-11-04: SIGNED ANCHORS (PM 2026-11-04). Score the TICKET AS WRITTEN (name, trigger, wrong-if) in YOUR method's terms: 5 = textbook, every condition my method requires is present and confirmed, nothing I treat as a veto is in play, I can name nothing I would still want to see; 4 = strong, all required conditions present, one supporting condition missing or unconfirmed and I can name it; 3 = qualified, a conditional yes: 'yes, once X'; 2 = marginal, a fair candidate but a required condition is failing or the trigger/wrong-if is not the one my method would use; 1 = weak as written, the ticket fails what my method requires (a better-written ticket on the same name could score higher). Never a size, never a probability. The committee conviction is the median of the deciders' scores; a readout, never a gate.

trigger_note.x_note: R40 AMENDED (PM 2026-11-19): the trigger is an ENTRY POINT, not a gate. A seat that disagrees with the ticket's trigger files its PREFERRED trigger here (a condition-vocab word with a FIELD level, its timeframe, plain words, inside the seat's own method) on an AGREE or AGREE_WITH_RESERVATION about the stock, never an OBJECT. It rides beside the slate's ONE trigger into consensus.json, pma_levels.json and card_fields.json for the alert layer, and is NOT counted toward the 4-of-7 drop.

objects_to.x_note: REQUIRED on OBJECT from 2026-11-20 (R40 amended 2026-11-19): OBJECT is for the STOCK only and is the only answer counted toward the 4-of-7 drop; a disagreement with the trigger is a trigger_note

objection.x_note: REQUIRED on OBJECT: the one thing wrong with the ticket as written

would_clear.x_note: REQUIRED on OBJECT: the one thing that would clear the objection

x_registrar_extra_checks: with --slate: the ticker set equals the slate's exactly (no missing, no extra)
OBJECT using a bracket as the disqualifier => REJECT (R1)
a ratification from a non-decider is REJECTED here and ignored loudly by ratify-count
